subject: Pilot extension request & tiered-commit outline
messages:
From: Elena Garcia <elena@finlytics.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@finlytics.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Pilot scope and request for additional runway

Hi Connor,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency profile and cost breakdown were exactly what our platform team wanted to see. We ran a quick internal sync and there are two asks before we can commit to a short POC: 1) a slightly longer evaluation window (our QA needs a second week to run synthetic scenarios), and 2) a bridge credit to cover the additional token usage while we complete integration.

Attached is our evaluation criteria spreadsheet with the scenarios we plan to run. High level: baseline integration (auth + ingest), throughput tests at 10k qps-equivalent, model quality checks on 5k prompts, and a security review.

Can Redwood extend the pilot by 14 days and provide an additional 200k token credit as a one-time bridge? We want the MAP spelled out (milestones + acceptance criteria) and a short note on conversion pricing if we hit the success metrics. Also please include any procurement steps so our legal team can plan.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Garcia
Head of Product
Finlytics

Attachments: finlytics-eval-criteria.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12KB)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Elena Garcia <elena@finlytics.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@finlytics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T11:37:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot scope and request for additional runway

Hi Elena — great to hear the demo landed well. Appreciate the evaluation sheet; that helps. Below is a concise MAP and commercial proposal that addresses the extension and conversion terms you asked for.

Mutual Action Plan (weeks from kick):
- Week 0 (kick): account onboarding, API keys, baseline ingest (owner: Finlytics + Redwood engs).
- Week 1: integration & smoke tests (success = baseline 95% ingest success rate).
- Week 2: throughput and latency tests (success = p50 < 180ms, sustained qps profile met).
- Week 3: quality signoff (Finlytics evaluates prompt set, target NPS >= 85) + security questionnaire completion.

Pilot logistics and credits:
- Original pilot: 300k token credit (spent). We can extend by 14 calendar days and add a one-time bridge credit of 200k tokens to cover the synthetic runs you described.
- If additional runway is still needed after the extension, Redwood can authorize a short addendum for another 100k tokens with manager approval.

Conversion pricing (post-pilot, standard offer):
- Option A (commit ladder): 3-month ramp commit starting at $3.50/1k tokens for months 1-2, stepping to $2.75/1k at month 3 once 500k tokens/month sustained consumption is reached.
- Option B (annual commit): 6-month minimum commit at $2.10/1k tokens with a 10% credit for pre-payment.
- We can include a one-time onboarding credit equal to 50% of the first month for early conversion.

Next steps I propose:
1) Finlytics confirms acceptance of the MAP milestones and the 14-day extension + 200k token bridge.
2) Redwood sends a short SOW addendum and a DocuSign link for the credit amendment.
3) Introduce procurement/legal contacts so we can route the SOW and invoice.

Looping Marissa (account exec) to confirm the credit approval and procurement path. If you confirm today we can get the addendum out this afternoon.

—Connor
Connor O'Brien
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: redwood-map-proposal-v1.pdf (proposal summary, 18KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot scope and request for additional runway (internal)

Connor — quick internal: I reviewed the ask. Approve the 200k bridge credit and 14-day extension; please note a couple of constraints: 1) the extra 100k top-up requires manager sign-off if requested after the extension, and 2) the commit ladder (Option A) needs legal to approve the step-down mechanics.

Procurement notes: Finance will accept a short SOW addendum + single invoice for the credit; legal prefers the SOW to state acceptance criteria tied to the MAP milestones (we should copy language from our standard POC clause). Also add a 30-day expiration on the credit amendment.

Make the SOW link and DocuSign explicit in the outbound to Finlytics. If they accept today I can push the addendum through review and get signatures by Friday.

-Marissa
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: SOW-draft.docx (word doc, 45KB)

From: Elena Garcia <elena@finlytics.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@finlytics.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T16:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot scope and request for additional runway

Connor / Marissa — thanks for the quick turnaround and for approving the bridge credit. Finlytics accepts the 14-day extension and the 200k token bridge. We also accept the MAP milestones as written.

Please send the SOW addendum and DocuSign link to legal@finlytics.com and I will have Raj route it to procurement. On conversion pricing, we are leaning toward Option A (commit ladder) but would like a short written example showing month-by-month expected invoice if we hit the 500k tokens/month ramp (helps our CFO).

Once the DocuSign is in place we will kick off the extended tests Monday morning. Appreciate the clear path.

Best,
Elena

Attachments referenced: none
